title: Your devices (files, other Xods, this computer)
about: Requests about the person's own devices: sending files to their phone and other computers, their other Xods, and looking after this computer, checked against what Xod's router and planner decide, with the This Mac connector connected. Scored by tool: want is the tool (tool.action) that should come first; never: tools that must not appear. Moving files to a device must use tailscale_files, not the shell.

cases.q: send ~/Desktop/report.pdf to my iphone
send the newest screenshot on my desktop to my phone
cases.note: Finding the file with ls is fine; the send itself must be tailscale_files.

cases.q: what devices can I send files to?
I just sent a photo from my phone, grab it
which of my computers have Xod running?
sign me in so my computers can find each other
have my other computer clean up its own Downloads folder
did my other computer finish the task I sent it?
what's using all my CPU right now?
what's running on port 3000? kill it
open Spotify
there's an Allow button on my screen, click it
what are you working on in the background right now?
is everything in Xod working ok?
organize my Downloads folder
hey, thanks for the help earlier
What did I work on today?
cases.note: Your own day: Xod's memory and tasks (or git), never the web.

cases.q: pause the muse approvals for an hour
stop auto approving muse stuff, I want to click them myself
only approve muse's cards when I'm not at my computer
is auto-approve on right now?
can you see if you can use any of my apps?
cases.note: Vague: say what Xod can do and ask which, never try tools at random.

cases.q: can you try to see if you can post to my Facebook? just something simple.
cases.note: The person's own account: the browser (it says when a sign-in is needed).

cases.q: open the calculator app on my phone
cases.note: My phone is the paired phone (Xod phone app), never a Mac Shortcut.

cases.q: what's on my phone's screen right now?
